description: This file defines functions related to audio device type sets, including retrieving specific device sets and converting device types to strings, within the Android media framework.

methods.name: getAudioDeviceOutAllSet
methods.description: Returns a DeviceTypeSet containing all output audio devices.

methods.name: getAudioDeviceOutAllA2dpSet
methods.description: Returns a DeviceTypeSet for all A2DP output devices.

methods.name: getAudioDeviceOutAllScoSet
methods.description: Returns a DeviceTypeSet for all SCO output devices.

methods.name: getAudioDeviceOutAllUsbSet
methods.description: Returns a DeviceTypeSet for all USB output devices.

methods.name: getAudioDeviceInAllSet
methods.description: Returns a DeviceTypeSet for all input audio devices.

methods.name: getAudioDeviceInAllUsbSet
methods.description: Returns a DeviceTypeSet for all USB input devices.

methods.name: getAudioDeviceOutAllBleSet
methods.description: Returns a DeviceTypeSet for all BLE output devices.

methods.name: getAudioDeviceOutLeAudioUnicastSet
methods.description: Returns a DeviceTypeSet for LE Audio unicast output devices.

methods.name: getAudioDeviceOutLeAudioBroadcastSet
methods.description: Returns a DeviceTypeSet for LE Audio broadcast output devices.

methods.name: deviceTypesToString
methods.description: Converts a DeviceTypeSet to a human-readable string.

methods.name: dumpDeviceTypes
methods.description: Returns a hex string representation of device types in a DeviceTypeSet.
